name: Request Onsite Parking for Hybrid Day
goal: Employee requests a parking spot for a day they plan to work onsite.
constraints: Parking availability must be checked for the requested date.

phases.description: User requests parking for a specific onsite day.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for the date and vehicle plate.

phases.description: User provides valid date and vehicle plate number.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot checks availability and confirms reservation.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
